study.question: Are group-localized marginal concentration summaries necessary, or can one global marginal distribution retain validation utility while reducing measured cost, with all other target-dependent information preserved?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: g2-r0018-full_summary AUC=0.6203373142, training=426.49s, inference=18.3943s, versus collision_only=0.6198746087, entropy_only=0.6200399010 and support_only=0.6197121693. Removing a statistic family lost utility; keeping both but removing match-group localization is untested. The first-512 diagnostic support is strongly dominated by neither-match events (107.87/118.12); this is not a population estimate. A whole-history category distribution and brand distribution may summarize the useful diversity/intensity signal with fewer bucket cells. Local supports, recency and action-age histograms retain candidate relevance. A failure would reject this implementation, not global compression in general or marginal concentration as a mechanism.

nearest_work.difference: DIN adapts embedded behavior pooling to the candidate. This field-adapted reference uses softmax although primary DIN relaxes normalization (lines272-277); no exact reproduction claim. Proposed change globally pools nonlearned marginal count distributions only; target-dependent recency/histogram/support paths remain. Global pooling and entropy/collision are established operations; no priority or broad novelty claim.

Author README confirms category/brand/type histories without item IDs. Publisher full paper unavailable through registry; no detailed DMR mechanism or reproduction claim. No unavailable item history or matching supervision is introduced.

Direct ancestor. Keep both entropy and with-replacement collision at the same 256-bucket mapping, changing localization only. Pooled control distinguishes removal of group association from computing a mixture distribution.

inherited_components: Frozen causal histories, complete-pair support mask(history_mask and category>0 and brand>0), splits, prevalence, scorer and supplied seed; no new inputs.

All static embeddings, action/recency embeddings, matched-capacity main MLP (158 first units at F=18), 28-to16-to1 bias-free residual head with zero final weight, and exact parameter allocation order from g2-r0018-full_summary.

All nonidentity features unchanged: four match counts, local action/coarse-age table, local fine-recency log-count weighting. Mapping salt0,256 bins, both marginal entropy and collision, normalization log129.
Natural host optimizer and loss unchanged; no custom training hooks.
study.proposed_difference: Three-cell replacement study: local replay computes Hc_g,Cc_g,Hb_g,Cb_g,Hc_g+Hb_g,Cc_g*Cb_g. Global candidate computes these six coordinates from the whole complete-pair prefix, using one Bx256 bucket table per field instead of Bx1024. Pooled control computes each original local six-vector, averages it with n_g/N (including averaging the product collision directly), then broadcasts it. Both replacements broadcast their six-vector only to occupied complete-pair groups. The separate four log1p(n_g)/log129 support coordinates are identical. This preserves module capacity and shape, but reduces effective input rank; equal allocated parameters do not imply equal function class or optimization. The test concerns concentration localization, not elimination of all target awareness or category-brand event pairing. Broader novelty remains unverified.
predictions: Primary preliminary retention screen: global AUC minus local replay >= -0.0002 and global AUC minus frozen g1-r0012-joint_identity >= -0.0002, with secondary Logloss worsening <=0.0002 against each. These are prospective practical margins, not significance thresholds; final support requires paired seeds and user-cluster uncertainty if feasible.

Global actual-forward identity bucket cells per field fall 1024->256 (2 tables retained), with no quadratic tensors, sequence sorting or learned bucket embeddings. End-to-end efficiency requires >=3% lower train_seconds or inference_seconds against local replay; p95 latency and peak memory also reported. No measured savings are assumed.

If pooled and global both retain utility, concentration group localization is dispensable in these implementations. If pooled fails but global succeeds, global mixture/overlap information may compensate for lost localization; pure localization sufficiency is unsupported. If pooled retains but global fails, cross-group merging rather than loss of localization is implicated.

Dense hashed-distribution oracle agrees with every selected cell within 2e-5; support identical; reversal/padding errors <=2e-5; empty/missing/zero-length history features and zero-input residual vanish. Localization and merging witnesses discriminate the modes. Host first512 diagnostics are algebra checks, not population attribution.
falsifiers: Global breaches either predeclared retention margin, or provides no repeatable >=3% measured training/inference saving; no utility-cost retention claim then.
Pooled fails while local succeeds: localization or its effective capacity/optimization is consequential; no unique concentration mechanism claim without further controls.
Any oracle/support/invariance failure, nonfinite logit, changed nonidentity source, unintended forward local-table computation in global mode, or unauthorized information invalidates that comparison.
Effects vanish or reverse over paired seeds/user-cluster intervals: treat screening outcomes as preliminary. One failure cannot refute compression generally.
alternative_explanations: Single seed, host timing noise, repeated validation selection and seed42 replay determinism can explain small AUC/cost differences; repeated same-seed replays are not independent evidence.

Broadcast replaces 24 group-associated coordinates with up to six shared values plus occupancy. Allocated parameters/initial RNG order match, but effective input rank and gradient scale differ. Pooled control shares this limitation and does not fully eliminate optimization confounding.

Global distributions add cross-group shared-ID information; pooled removes localization without merging distributions. Their difference is a semantic replacement effect, not a uniquely identified causal effect of cross-group overlap.

Hash collisions, small complete-pair groups, static frequency correlates or label propensity may drive summary utility rather than interest diversity. Neither product summaries nor this study establish within-event category-brand pairing.
Earlier temporal factorization hurt (g2-r0016-log_local=0.6202837665 versus log_factorized=0.6198141460); preserving recency localization is necessary to isolate this distinct question.
Static snapshot as-of dates remain undocumented; benchmark generalization to production point-in-time data is unverified.

Knowledge boundary: personal knowledge is disabled, and scoped agent-memory searches returned no matches; no personal file was created. Prior source usage is provenance only. Runtime ownership permits only proposal.json and candidate modules here, so new local check provenance is appended to these registered notes for host receipt/memory ingestion, not written to human-owned or read-only evidence. No new open-memory record of withheld outcomes exists.

contrasts.decision_if_supported: Repeat global/local on paired seeds43,44 and compare to frozen joint_identity before claiming utility retention; keep measured frontier rather than AUC winner alone.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: Retain both summaries locally; use pooled contrast to decide whether loss of localization or global mixture replacement deserves a discriminating follow-up.

contrasts.intervention: pooled_summary: support-weighted average of six conditional coordinates broadcast to occupied groups
held_fixed: same base features, module allocation, initial RNG and host training
remaining_confounds: loss of effective group-coordinate rank in pooled/global
global mixture and pooled conditional statistics are different summaries
contrasts.decision_if_supported: If pooled retains, local association is dispensable provisionally; use global/pooled gap to assess cross-group merging and measured-cost tradeoff.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: If both replacements fail, retain local summaries without claiming that target localization alone is the mechanism; consider capacity/optimization replacement only with budgeted controls.
